$comment: Every channel Lev Yam publishes to, and the one home of derivative sizes (docs/plans/content-media-foundation.md §Homes; ADR 0068 §2, ADR 0069 §6). Nothing live reads this file (ADR 0069 §5). scripts/check-content.mjs validates modes, presets and utm_source today; until scripts/media.sh (PR C) writes from the presets, scripts/story-images.sh and the /app/events upload still carry their own numbers, which must equal these. limits and freshness are read by the content-week skill (PR C) and the freshness numbers (PR D). A `publish` mode needs `publish_adr` naming an ADR whose title names the channel id (ADR 0068 §2).

channels.name: levyam.com (homepage, /stories/, /happening/)
channels.connector: the repo — Claude opens the PR, the owner merges (CLAUDE.md gate)

story-hero.note: img/stories/<slug>/hero-1600.jpg and hero-800.jpg — the page hero (media/README.md)

story-figure.note: img/stories/<slug>/<name>-1600.jpg and -800.jpg — a figure in the text; a WhatsApp copy may go here when the size fits

gallery.note: srcset rungs named by real width — min(original, 960); the jpg fallback is the original's web copy

share.note: the homepage og:image — check-content's share rule

events-photo.note: the /app/events browser upload (ADR 0059): the photo and its -sm.jpg copy; app-src/src/modules/events/api.ts MAX_EDGE / THUMB_EDGE must agree

ig-reel.note: video/GUIDELINES.md §2–3 for lengths and safe zones

ig-feed-video.note: a re-layout of the 9:16 composition, never a letterbox

cover.note: a reel's cover still — headline inside the centre 4:5 crop (GUIDELINES §2)

wa-status.note: specs unverified — check the upload once (GUIDELINES §2)
